table_name: Table 7F - Requirements for Firefighting Installations - For Mercantile Buildings
band_matching_convention: See table7a_residential.json for the shared convention and confidence-tagging rules.

bands.condition: Up to 30 m height, area 501-1000 sqm
Up to 30 m height, area 1001 sqm and above

bands.note: Refer to hydraulic-calculation note / Annex D provisions.

notes: If the building has a basement requiring sprinkler protection, protection level upgrades to CL-3.
If the building has EV parks in podium/basement, must be sprinklered and comply with CL-5.
Supplementary protection for specific hazard/critical rooms per Table 9/10/11 as applicable.
Pump pressure/quantity must be supported by hydraulic calculations.
If building height exceeds 30 m, must comply with hydraulic-calculation-based system architecture.
If building height exceeds 60 m, multi-level pumping/storage with gravity-redundant down-comer; pumps should not exceed 12 bar shutoff pressure.
Rate-of-rise heat detection in EV parking/charging areas; smoke detectors in basements except ICE parks (CO sensors).
